title: Dataset-Split overview (CICIoT2023, post-rebalance)
_note: This manifest covers two figures (F0a, F0b) emitted by a single script run. The stage_distribution.png and dataset_summary.json output pins were re-baselined after regenerating both artifacts from the current leakage-fixed splits: the committed versions predated the OOD-reservation fix and reported the pre-fix per-stage counts (309,566 train rows instead of 235,324), contradicting Ch. 4 prose. class_distribution.png regenerated byte-identical, confirming the plotter is deterministic and the drift was confined to the split-dependent figure. See docs/mentor_review/01_dataset.md §3 Finding 5 for the rationale behind splitting figure_id into figure_ids/figures. The splits/manifest.json input pin is re-baselined to the current leakage-fixed (post-3cd2fb9) generation; that file embeds a non-deterministic `generated_at` timestamp so its SHA is machine-local and is re-pinned per regeneration. The split *content* is fully reproducible (seed 42, ratios 0.7/0.1/0.2): all 15 split-index output SHAs are internally consistent and OOD classes are leakage-free. data/processed/ is gitignored, so on a fresh clone this input is absent and the check SKIPs.
